title: Shape Machine
body:
Goal: make your own block, polygon, with two inputs (sides and length), and use it to draw many shapes with one block each. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension. Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project. Click Add Extension (bottom left) and choose Pen. Set the cat's Size to 40.
  2. Click My Blocks > Make a Block. Type polygon.
  3. Click Add an input (number or text) and type sides. Click it again and type length. Click OK. (Leave "Run without screen refresh" unticked.)
  4. A pink define polygon (sides) (length) hat appears. Build the steps under it. To use an input, drag the little sides or length oval out of the define hat into a slot. The / (divide) block is in Operators.
  5. Build the green-flag script using your new pink polygon block four times.
  6. Click the green flag.
  7. Add a pentagon with one more block: polygon 5 70.
  8. Save as shape-machine.

The scripts in words

define polygon (sides) (length)

  • pen down
  • repeat (sides):
    • move (length) steps
    • turn right (360 / sides) degrees
  • pen up

when green flag clicked

  • erase all
  • go to x: 0 y: 0
  • point in direction 90
  • polygon 3 120
  • polygon 4 100
  • polygon 6 60
  • polygon 8 40

Expected behavior

Each click on the green flag clears the stage and draws four shapes that all start from the middle: a big triangle, a square, a hexagon and a small octagon. Every shape closes. Adding polygon 5 70 adds a pentagon.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Look at the pink define polygon block you make in the My Blocks category. Everything that draws one shape goes under it. The green-flag script only uses the new block.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: A shape with many sides is the same two steps repeated: move forward, then turn. Put those two steps in a repeat block (Control category). Drag the sides and length ovals out of the define hat into the slots.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Under the define block, put pen down first and pen up last. In the middle, use a repeat that uses your sides oval, with a move and a turn inside. For the turn, use the divide block from the Operators category. A full turn is 360 degrees.
